## Diagnosis → fix summary

**Root cause:** Lumina pivoted from an email-cleanup product (InboxZap) to an AI meeting assistant, but the SEO foundation never caught up. GSC data (`gsc/Queries.csv`, `gsc/Pages.csv`) shows **100% of existing impressions are for InboxZap-era queries** ("bulk delete emails," "inbox zero," "gmail storage full") — none of which relate to the current product — and those 12 posts were already ranking poorly (position 40–58) before the pivot. Meanwhile the blog that should carry new, relevant content was completely non-functional.

### Scorecard (Phase 0)

| Lane | Status | Why |
|---|---|---|
| SEO | ⚠️→✅ | Homepage SSR/meta fine, but `app/layout.tsx` still shipped stale InboxZap title/description as the site-wide default; sitemap omitted all blog posts |
| AEO | ❌→✅ | Zero FAQPage/Article structured data anywhere; `/faq` 301-redirected to `/#faq`, an anchor that didn't exist on the page |
| GEO | ❌→✅ | No `llms.txt`; nothing to correct an LLM's stale "InboxZap" association |
| LLMO | ⚠️→✅ | `og:image` referenced on every page 404s (not fixed — see below) |
| NEO | n/a | English-market SaaS, out of scope |
| Content ops | ❌→✅ | `/blog` depended on a client-side fetch to `/api/posts`, which 404s — the blog has never rendered content to anyone, human or crawler |

### What changed (before → after)

- `app/layout.tsx`: default metadata was still `"InboxZap — Clean Your Inbox in Minutes"` → now Lumina, with a title template.
- `app/page.tsx`: added a real `#faq` section (matching the `/faq` redirect target) with `FAQPage` + `Organization` + `SoftwareApplication` JSON-LD.
- `app/blog/page.tsx` + new `app/blog/[slug]/page.tsx`: removed the broken client-side `/api/posts` fetch entirely; posts now SSR from `content/posts.ts` with per-post metadata, canonical, and `Article`/`FAQPage` JSON-LD.
- `content/posts.ts` (new): 3 question-mapped pages — a rebrand bridge post (captures the still-healthy "inboxzap" brand query), plus two posts answering real buyer questions for the current product.
- `next.config.js`: 301-redirect all 12 legacy InboxZap posts into the rebrand post, consolidating link equity instead of leaving off-topic orphaned pages live.
- `app/sitemap.ts`: now includes the real blog posts instead of a `// TODO` stub.
- `public/llms.txt` (new): current product facts + an explicit note that "InboxZap" info is outdated.
- `content/backlog.md` (new): question backlog, redirect rationale, and the measurement plan below.

### Crawler-eye verification (curl, no JS)

- Homepage: correct title/description, `FAQPage`/`Organization`/`SoftwareApplication` JSON-LD present, `id="faq"` section present.
- `/blog` and `/blog/how-ai-meeting-notes-work`: full content in raw HTML, no loading spinner, correct `<title>`/meta/`Article`/`FAQPage` JSON-LD.
- `/blog/post-1` → `308 Permanent Redirect` → `/blog/inboxzap-is-now-lumina`.
- `/faq` → `308 Permanent Redirect` → `/#faq` (now a real anchor).
- `/sitemap.xml` lists the 3 real posts, no legacy slugs.
- `/llms.txt` → `200`.
- `npm run build` compiles clean; all 3 posts statically generated.

### Next measurement (Phase 6)

Re-pull the GSC export on **2026-12-08** and check: (1) any impressions on the two new question pages, (2) whether the "inboxzap" brand query's CTR holds now that it lands on a real page, (3) Search Console shows the 12 old URLs as "page with redirect" rather than indexed.

### Not done, and why

- **`og:image` 404s on every page** (`/img/og-lumina.png`) — this breaks social/AI preview cards but I'm not fabricating a binary image asset to paper over a missing one. Flagged in `content/backlog.md` for someone to supply a real 1200×630 PNG.
- Didn't rewrite the 12 legacy posts to "fit" Lumina — they're genuinely about email cleanup; forcing a meetings angle would make the content and JSON-LD say something untrue.
- Didn't touch backlinks — out of scope per the skill's no-shortcuts rule.
- Didn't upgrade Next.js (14.2.5 has a known CVE) — real issue, but it's a security/dependency concern, not an SEO one, so left for a separate pass.
